objective: Enforce delegation-first DDR ownership with bounded current-orchestrator exceptions.
constraints: Keep native-host and CLI/user-local callable surfaces distinct.
Use deterministic proof as acceptance authority.
out_of_scope: merging native-host identities into the CLI catalog
acceptance_criteria: Delegated execution is the normal owner after orchestration.
The pickup host resolves each portable complexity tier to an exact live qualified route.
Current execution requires a recognized reason code.
no-qualified-route is disproved by an eligible CLI route.
Windows junction and canonical paths share project identity while missing paths fail closed.
Independent ready slices may run on separate tier-qualified subagents in parallel.
Focused selector, CLI, and skill contract tests pass.
model_tier_reason: The behavior is bounded to an existing Go selector and documented CLI contract, with deterministic tests.
escalation_triggers: Existing public callers rely on arbitrary current-owner reasons.
The selector cannot distinguish native-host evidence from CLI catalog evidence.
